name: Tungsten ditelluride, Td phase

driven_states.emergent_property: THz-driven large-amplitude interlayer shear strain drives the system into a metastable, centrosymmetric polytype: the Weyl nodes are annihilated in pairs and the topological invariant changes. Shear displacement about 8 picometers, corresponding to 1.3 per cent strain, built up over about 25 picoseconds.
driven_states.source: Sie, Nyby, Pemmaraju, Park, Shen et al., Nature 565, 61 (2019), doi:10.1038/s41586-018-0809-4
driven_states.caveat: The change of topology is inferred, not measured: what is demonstrated is the structure via diffraction and the inversion symmetry via second harmonic generation; that the Weyl nodes thereby disappear follows from a symmetry argument and calculation. No transport, no Berry curvature measurement in the driven state. The field of 7.5 MV/cm is close to the damage threshold - lattice heating is not fully excluded, but the anharmonic mode softening argues for a coherently driven pathway.

threshold.quantity: deviation from harmonic shear behavior only at very high field

driven_states.measured_quantity: relativistic electron diffraction, shear displacement in picometers; second harmonic generation as an indicator of inversion symmetry

gaps: Change of topology inferred, not measured.
